title: Shopping on Saturday
text:
Maria goes to the supermarket on Saturday. She needs bread, milk and eggs. The bread costs two euros. She pays at the counter and says thank you.

After that, she goes to the shoe shop. She wants a new pair of shoes because her old shoes are too small. The shoes are red and they are very nice. She buys them and feels happy.

questions.text: What does Maria need at the supermarket?
Why does Maria want new shoes?
options: Her old shoes are too small.

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel after she buys the shoes?
What kind of person is Maria most likely to be?

vocabulary.definition: a large shop that sells food and other everyday things
a long table where you pay in a shop
things you wear on your feet

paragraph_translations: María va al supermercado el sábado. Necesita pan, leche y huevos. El pan cuesta dos euros. Ella paga en el mostrador y dice gracias.
Después, va a la tienda de zapatos. Quiere un par de zapatos nuevos porque sus zapatos viejos son muy pequeños. Los zapatos son rojos y son muy bonitos. Ella los compra y se siente feliz.
